sections.p: HiBiz AI ("HiBiz", "we") provides an AI-based business monitoring service that delivers insights and alerts over WhatsApp. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it.

When you submit our contact form we collect the details you provide: your name, work email, business name, industry, and any message you include. We do not collect payment details through this website.

We use your contact details solely to respond to your inquiry, schedule demos, and share relevant information about the HiBiz service. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.
This website uses browser local storage to remember your language preference and accessibility settings. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
The website is hosted on Vercel. Form submissions may be processed by our email and CRM providers strictly for the purposes described above.
We keep inquiry details only as long as needed to handle your request. You may ask us to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time by emailing eyal@hibiz.dev.
For any privacy question or request, contact us at eyal@hibiz.dev.
By accessing this website you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

HiBiz AI provides business monitoring, analytics and alerting delivered through messaging platforms. Content on this website is provided for general information and does not constitute business or financial advice.
You agree to use the website lawfully and not to attempt to disrupt, probe, or gain unauthorized access to it or to any related systems.
All content on this website — text, design, graphics and logos — belongs to HiBiz AI or its licensors and may not be reproduced without written permission.

The website is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, HiBiz AI shall not be liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the website.
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Israel, and the competent courts in Israel shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
Questions about these terms? Contact us at eyal@hibiz.dev.

HiBiz AI is committed to making its website accessible to people with disabilities, in accordance with the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities regulations (IS 5568) and WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.

The site supports full keyboard navigation with visible focus indicators, proper heading structure and ARIA labels, alternative text for images, right-to-left and Hebrew language support, and respects the system's reduced-motion preference.

An accessibility menu is available on every page (the accessibility button at the corner of the screen). It allows enlarging text, increasing contrast, stopping animations, and highlighting links. Preferences are saved for your next visit.
Some third-party photographs are decorative. If you encounter any content that is difficult to access, we would appreciate your feedback and will address it promptly.
Found an accessibility issue, or need assistance? Email us at eyal@hibiz.dev and we will respond as quickly as possible.
